steps.en: Clone the public copy and install its pinned Bun dependencies
steps.zh: 克隆公开副本，按锁文件安装 Bun 依赖

steps.en: Ask it to rebuild the README ranking tables
steps.zh: 让它重建 README 里的排名表

steps.en: Recomputes paired cost-per-solve ratios from trial records and diffs the tables
steps.zh: 从试次记录重算成对的单题成本比，并比对表格

steps.en: Ask it to replay every published run's analysis
steps.zh: 让它重放每个已发布运行的分析

steps.en: Reruns each run's analysis on its committed receipts and fails on any changed value
steps.zh: 在已提交的回执上重跑分析，任何数值不同就失败

value.en: You can recheck every published harness ranking without an API key, instead of trusting a leaderboard screenshot
value.zh: 不用 API key 就能复核每条公开的 harness 排名，不必信一张榜单截图
